## Scope check
This repo is **scoped only to OpenClaw** detection, uninstall, and validation. Requests must stay in scope (e.g. new artifact type, new platform, dry-run improvements, SIEM/MDM docs).

- [ ] This request is in scope (detection, uninstall, verification, CI, docs for same).

## Problem or goal
What problem does this solve, or what capability do you need?

## Proposed solution
Describe the enhancement (e.g. new flag, new path to remove, new doc).

## Alternatives considered
Any other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context
Platform, use case (e.g. MDM, SIEM), or links to OpenClaw docs if relevant.
